text:
olivia.sales: Heads-up — NovaBank POC in eu-central-1 hit a hard stop while applying Dedicated reservation. They were trying to reserve 6x A100 for a 2-week POC with strict-region=true.

sam_se: what error are they getting?

olivia.sales: pasted from UI when clicking 'Confirm reservation':

`Reservation failed: capacity_unavailable: requested 6 A100, region eu-central-1 has 4 available. Please contact support or change region.`

rachel_platform: ok that's a provider capacity shortfall. Did they select "allow-fallback" or "mixed-instance"?

olivia.sales: they selected neither — security requires keys and data never leave eu-central-1. They explicitly chose strict-region.

sam_se: that combination explains the failure. Two paths: 1) we do a provider-side capacity reservation (24-72h) if they sign the short commitment; 2) offer a reduced demo with 4 GPUs now and plan a full commit later. Both need finance/legal sign-off for a POC reservation.

claudia_legal: FYI legal: we have a POC addendum template that covers 2-week reserved trials. We typically don't do 1-week due to provisioning windows. If customer insists on 1 week we can draft, but ops may not be able to guarantee fulfillment.

olivia.sales: customer asked specifically if we can do 1-week paid commitment just for demo day (urgency: exec meeting).

tom_ops: from an ops POV, provider reservations are billed by the provider and it takes 24-48h to get confirmed. For a true in-region 6x A100 we need the reservation API call executed and confirmed by the provider. If customer needs same-day demo we should carve a temporary 4x pool and mark it as "poc-temp".

quota-bot: [quota-check] region eu-central-1: available A100=4, H100=8, ephemeral spare=2

sam_se: we can propose an interim plan: temporary 4x A100 pool for demo + pricing quote for 6x reserved (2-week minimum). Pricing note: reserved 6x A100 in eu-central-1 = baseline * 1.25 per GPU. Mixed-profile (4xA100+2xH100) would be baseline * 1.35 effective. I'll draft numbers.

olivia.sales: NovaBank security team also pinged about KMS: they require CMKs to stay in their VPC and no customer data to leave region. Does our Dedicated POC flow support customer-managed keys and VPC-restricted traffic?

rachel_platform: yes, our Dedicated control plane supports customer KMS with VPC-only access. For provider reservations we still need network peering and the pool must be tagged with `customer:kms-bound`. Ops note: when creating the temporary pool ensure the subnet attachments are the customer's private subnets.

claudia_legal: OL: ensure SOW and addendum include explicit clause about "no cross-region fallback" and that capacity reservation fulfillment is subject to provider availability.

olivia.sales: understood. I'll relay. Customer says they won't accept cross-region for compliance.

tom_ops: action items then:
- carve temp pool 4x A100 in eu-central-1 with labels `poc-novabank-1769301234` and `kms-bound=true` -> tom_ops
- run acceptance/latency smoke tests -> rachel_platform
- send pricing + 2-week reservation addendum -> sam_se + claudia_legal
- check if we can do expedited provider reservation (expedite fee?) -> finance (cc sam_se)

deploy-bot: [deployment] provisioning job queued job-5521 by tom_ops at 2026-03-20T08:40:00Z

quota-bot: [info] allocation check: job-5521 requesting 4x A100 -> available=4 -> allocation OK

deploy-bot: [info] job-5521 completed: allocated 4x A100 to pool `poc-novabank-1769301234` at 2026-03-20T09:02:11Z

rachel_platform: running acceptance tests now. I'll post results (p50, throughput, kv hits).

sam_se: draft quote uploaded to ticket NB-POC-77: 4x temp A100 (demo) = $X/day; 6x reserved 2-week = $Y flat (includes regional premium). Also included mixed-instance option and timeline note.

olivia.sales: customer on call accepted the 4x temp demo, will review 2-week quote. They also asked: "can we see logs/metrics during the demo?"

rachel_platform: yes — we'll share a temporary dashboard link with read-only access and a short walkthrough. Ensure no sensitive keys in logs.

rachel_platform: acceptance results: p50=33ms, throughput=950 tokens/s, kv-cache-hit=78% — acceptable for demo load.

tom_ops: all set. Marking thread for follow-up on reservation commit. If customer signs, ops will initiate provider reservation and target 24-48h fulfillment.

claudia_legal: I'll prepare the 2-week addendum. If they push 1-week we'll escalate with clear terms that provisioning lead time is not guaranteed.

olivia.sales: thanks team. I'm closing this slack thread for now, continuing contract stuff in NB-POC-77. Will reopen if they request strict 6x immediately.
